description_en: Deletes an application from a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster
description_zh: 调用DeleteK8sApplication接口删除容器服务K8s应用
name: DeleteK8sApplication

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application that you want to delete. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly delete the application and disable application deletion protection
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制删除应用，跳过应用删除保护
parameters.name: force
